title: spantruth results document, schema version 1
description: What `spantruth run` and `spantruth doctor` write. A reader ignores keys it does not know: a new key is not a breaking change. A key that goes away, changes its type or changes its meaning raises `schema`. See schema/README.md.

schema.description: The version of this document's shape. Documents written before spantruth 0.3.0 have no key, and have the shape of version 1.

spantruth.description: The spantruth version that wrote the document.

created.description: When the run started, ISO 8601 in UTC.

mode.description: `pinned`: the subjects' own versions. `latest`: their tracked packages unpinned.

python.description: The Python version of the subject environments.

semconv_genai.description: The semantic-conventions-genai commit that the checks follow.

overrides.description: The `--with` requirements of the run, when it had any.

scenarios.description: Each scenario that ran, by its ID.

subjects.description: Each subject that ran, by its name.

verdict.description: Ordered by severity. A cell takes the most severe verdict of its checks.

truth.description: What a correct instrumentation reports for the call. null: the wire carries no value, so the fact is not graded.

cache_write_long_tokens.description: Added in spantruth 0.5.0: the part of the cache writes cached for 1 hour.

ref.description: How the subject was named: a built-in name, or a directory path.

versions.description: The installed version of each package that the subject asked for.

error.description: Why the subject did not run, or why its baseline failed.

cells.description: One cell per scenario that applies to the subject.

stderr.description: The end of the subject's stderr, when the cell has no observation.

id.description: A check ID. It never changes meaning.

expected.description: The value that the wire carried.

got.description: The value that the span reported.

where.description: The attribute that the value came from.

rule.description: The rule that the check applies, or an empty string.

rule_url.description: A permalink to the rule, or an empty string.

status.description: UNSET, OK or ERROR, or the raw code when it is another number.
